description: This file defines the NotesListWidgetData class, which extends AbstractWidgetData and represents widget configuration data for a notes application, including display mode and category filtering.

classes.name: NotesListWidgetData
classes.description: Represents widget data for a notes list, including display mode and optional category filter, with database entity annotations for persistence.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category filter applied to the notes list widget, if any.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the category filter for the notes list widget.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the display mode for the widget, constrained between 0 and 2.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the current display mode of the widget.
